description:
FILED s526w2 (Opus, resumed s528 2026-10-25), from the Log-Log4perl-1.58 board census (the debug lines appear in every Log4perl test's output; t/020Easy.t row 19 reads them as its got).  PRE-EXISTING (main 31cd8c02).  NOT REDUCED to a small program.

    ./pl2cl --module < ~/.cpan/build/Log-Log4perl-1.58-0/lib/Log/Log4perl/Appender.pm
  emits, for line 63 `print "Appender class $appenderclass loaded OK ($@)\n" if _INTERNAL_DEBUG;`:
        (p-if "_INTERNAL_DEBUG" (p-print ...))
  where every later sub (lines 120-270) gets (p-if (p-scalar-ctx (|Log::Log4perl::Appender|::pl-_INTERNAL_DEBUG)) ...).  The unit's detect table agrees: lines 29 and 63 "unknown", lines 120..270 "proto:".
  perl: the constant is 0, nothing printed.  Probe scratch/s526w2/pconst.pl: perl "made"; PCL prints the three debug lines first.
BISECT (scratch/s526w2/pa1.pm, pa2.pm): deleting lines 97-106 (`if (!$INC{'Log/Log4perl/Config.pm'}) { require Log::Log4perl::Config; }` + the compile_if_perl `if`) fixes it; so does deleting lines 113-307 (every sub AFTER new).  The first 70 lines alone are right (pm3.pm).  A minimal module (`use constant _DBG => 0; sub f { print "a" if _DBG }`) is right.  So the parse of `sub new` happens -- or is redone -- with an environment that does not hold this package's constant, triggered by the `require` of a sibling module that declares the SAME constant name in ANOTHER package (Log::Log4perl::Config line 16) together with something in the later subs.  Suspect the prototype merge of a required module (a re-parse / scope of the constant record by bare name).
ROWS: t/020Easy.t 19 and the stdout noise in every Log4perl file; everyday-shaped (any Log4perl user).

=== DONE (s529b, Opus, 2026-10-31) ===
MECHANISM (reduced from Appender.pm by a line-level ddmin, scratch/s529b/reduce.pl -> app-red.pm, then to a two-module fixture): Parser2::_premerge_use_constant_prototypes registered a file's own `use constant` names with the package stack at its pre-pass value, `main`.  The include pre-merge positions a `require`d module's prototype records in the package the `require` compiles in (#3143), so `require Log::Log4perl::Config` inside Appender::new merged Config's own `_INTERNAL_DEBUG` (a `()` record, imported by the zero-arg rule of #365) into Log::Log4perl::Appender, SITED at the require (line 98).  The per-package table then held {Config, Appender(imported@98), main(own@12)}: Appender's own record was under `main`, so a read ABOVE line 98 (lines 29-86) saw "unknown" (#2871: a record is not in force above its site).  `no strict` in a LATER sub (`filter`) only decided what an unknown bareword becomes: no strict-subs -> the string.  Hence the string in `new` and a call in every later sub.
FIX: the pre-merge registers in `_package_of_element($inc)` (local package_stack, exactly as the include pre-merge does).  Corpus-diff then caught a second, pre-existing hole in that shared helper: a preceding `package NAME { ... }` BLOCK was taken to govern the statements after it (perl-tests/index.t's `package o { use overload ... }` moved main's `use constant quire/bang/u` into `o`) -- `_package_of_element` now skips a block-form package sibling.
GUARD: Pl/t/constant-scope-01.t (12 rows; rows 1-3 + 6-9 FAIL on main d8577478, rows 4-5 guard the block-sibling rule, rows 10-12 single-file inverses that were right).  The pcl rows run with `PCL_XSERVER=` -- a SERVED pl2cl drops perl's -I, so inside a gate row the module transpile never found C3870::B and the bug did not reproduce (FILED #4041).
ACCEPTANCE: `pl2cl --module < Log/Log4perl/Appender.pm` reads `(|Log::Log4perl::Appender|::pl-_INTERNAL_DEBUG)` at lines 63 / 75 / 86 (detect table "proto:" at 29, 63, 75, 86; no `main` row); one-file run t/020Easy.t: no "Appender class ... loaded OK" / "Calling ... new" line in the output; row 19 still fails, now on the caller-fidelity cause like row 18 (got '... logcroak in whack' without "at FILE line 190") -> its baselines/cpan-board14-fails.tsv row RE-ATTRIBUTED by edit (NS caller fidelity + #233).
subject: SILENT WRONG: inside Log::Log4perl::Appender's `sub new`, the `use constant _INTERNAL_DEBUG => 0` name is emitted as the bareword STRING "_INTERNAL_DEBUG" (true) -- every Log4perl program prints "Appender class ... loaded OK" / "Calling ... new" debug lines on STDOUT
